release_notes: Introduced hierarchical folder navigation with expandable tree support
Optimized large playlist processing, scrolling, and memory usage
Improved playback stability with real hardware acceleration support
Enhanced playlist and SQLite synchronization for reliable data persistence
Improved playback position tracking and Recent Media performance
Added dynamic light and dark theme support with complete RTL localization
Improved mobile controls, gestures, responsive navigation, and notch handling
Added Windows window state persistence and high-DPI display support
Improved native window sizing, layout behavior, and Android resize support
Expanded cross-platform stability and runtime performance
